_comment: The words of the AI section in Settings: the player's own AI (a text provider, and ComfyUI for pictures) and its
Test buttons. What the AI is asked is not here: it is the mods' ai/prompts.json. A label is said one way (the
first line of its pool). {name} is a value the game fills in.
{tokens}: settings.ai.detail.tokens (the most a line of a talk sends, the game's guess)

lines.settings.ai.note: Your own AI can write what the rivals say, the street talk and the paper's stories, and lets you talk to the sellers, the salesmen and the racers (a model of 8B or more talks best). The game never waits for it: its own words are always there, and what the AI writes is kept in the save.
lines.settings.ai.enabled: Use my AI for what people say and write
lines.settings.ai.key.hint: kept encrypted for this Windows user
lines.settings.ai.key.saved: A key is saved, encrypted. Type a new one to change it.
lines.settings.ai.key.insecure: The key is not sent over plain http to another machine: use an https address.
lines.settings.ai.sent_away: This address is not on this PC: with each request, the facts of your career (your name, cars, money, races, what people remember) and what you type in a talk go there.
lines.settings.ai.detail.light: Light: the main facts and the last few lines
lines.settings.ai.detail.normal: Normal: most facts, a fair stretch of the talk
lines.settings.ai.detail.tokens: Up to about {tokens:N0} tokens sent with each line of a talk, usually far fewer. Less costs a paid provider less, and a slow one answers sooner.
lines.settings.ai.ollama.note: Makes a model of the game's own in Ollama, from one you have pulled: tuned to talk like the town.
lines.settings.ai.ollama.made: Made {model} from {from}. Save to use it.
lines.settings.ai.ollama.failed: Could not make it from {from} (pull it first with "ollama pull {from}"): {error}
lines.settings.ai.ollama.not_pulled: {from} is not in Ollama yet: pull it first with "ollama pull {from}", then make the game's model.
lines.settings.ai.ollama.none: No mod has an Ollama model (ai/ollama.json).
lines.settings.ai.comfy: Paint new rivals' portraits with ComfyUI
